dct_description_sm: Note that the inset map was not georeferenced.

Georeferenced map of Lower Similkameen Band reserves Alexis 9 and Ashnola 10 along the Similkameen River where it meets the Ashnola River. Lower Similkameen Band Reserves Keremeos 12 and 12A are shown but not georeferenced here. Land cover and features described on the map includes the types of land, soil, and timber. The inset map was not georeferenced.
